answer: Identity here is a graft, not a ballot: each newcomer needs three mutually unrelated sponsors who lock collateral slashed if its behavior diverges, so a thousand fakes demand a thousand independent roots instead of one script. Standing grows like a vine up those grafts and cannot be transplanted to a fresh key. Unattested arrivals queue at a subsidized oasis funded by forfeited bonds, while trust crosses the ocean of separate operators slowly.
